def max_sub_array_sum_repeated(arr, n, k):
    max_so_far = float('-inf')
    curr = 0
    total_len = n * k
    for i in range(total_len):
        curr += arr[i % n]
        if curr > max_so_far:
            max_so_far = curr
        if curr < 0:
            curr = 0
    return max_so_far
